modelNotes: Futures Super Finals and US Club Championships are weighted equally for girls groups.
Teams that played both major events receive additional confidence but not automatic ranking priority.
Common-opponent crossover results are considered when teams only played one of the two major events.
D1/D2/D3 and A/B/C team-depth guardrails are applied before publication.
Manual same-team alias cleanup was expanded and audited in v3 to reduce duplicate club/team profiles.
Lamorinda A remains the A team; Lamorinda B and Lamorinda Gold are consolidated as the B-level profile; Lamorinda C remains separate.
Teams with fewer than five tracked games are held from the public 14U Girls ranking unless alias merges bring the profile above threshold.
